Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

refresh-emrbench · evaluates: The EMRBench study-design section specifies 10 replicas per task per model configuration.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.emrbench.replicates.v2

  • The report’s illustrated case separately describes two attempts; the task/replica relationship and all result denominators are not independently reconciled.
  • No published success-rate ranking is adopted, particularly given the report’s conflicting percentages and numerator/denominator summaries.

refresh-emrbench · benchmark task: The EMRBench report uses OpenEMR workflows with a fixture described as more than 1,200 clinical encounters across 67 synthetic patients.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.emrbench.synthetic-fixture.v2

  • Synthetic fixture counts are creator-reported. No private patient data, clinical efficacy or real-world safety validation is established.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

refresh-emrbench · benchmark task: EMRBench distinguishes clinical retrieval tasks, such as looking up records, from clinical actions involving prescriptions, scheduling or documentation.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.emrbench.workflow-types.v2

  • This is a documented task taxonomy, not a clinical recommendation, measured clinician-burden reduction or an audited success rubric.
